title: List a sewing machine
ask: Mum is downsizing and I'm listing her sewing machine. What we know is in item.md and recent sales are in comps.csv. Please draft it.
background: It is a mechanical machine from the 1990s, all metal inside, serviced in 2024.
The foot pedal cord has been re-taped where it meets the plug.
Mum would like it to go to someone who will use it.

constraints.text: write the price as "Price: $..." and keep it between $150 and $190
keep the first line, the title, to 55 characters or fewer
draft only, don't post it yet
mention the re-taped foot pedal cord

start.item.md:
Mechanical sewing machine, 1990s, serviced 2024.
Foot pedal cord re-taped at plug.
Includes 6 bobbins, 3 presser feet, manual.
Pickup: Hornsby.
